gospel.title: Holy Gospel of Jesus Christ according to Saint Mark
gospel.text:
[[Mc 10,13]]People were bringing children to Jesus that he might touch them, but the disciples rebuked them.
[[Mc 10,14]]When Jesus saw this he became indignant and said to them, "Let the children come to me; do not prevent them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
[[Mc 10,15]]Amen, I say to you, whoever does not accept the kingdom of God like a child will not enter it."
[[Mc 10,16]]Then he embraced them and blessed them, placing his hands on them.

psalm.title: Psalms
psalm.text:
[[Ps 103,13]]As a father has compassion on his children, 
so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
[[Ps 103,14]]For he knows how we are formed, 
remembers that we are dust.

[[Ps 103,15]]Man's days are like those of grass; 
like a flower of the field he blooms;
[[Ps 103,16]]The wind sweeps over him and he is gone, 
and his place knows him no more.

[[Ps 103,17]]But the kindness of the LORD is from eternity 
to eternity toward those who fear him, 
and his justice toward children's children
[[Ps 103,18a]]among those who keep his covenant.

first_reading.text:
[[Si 17,1]]God from the earth created man, and in his own image he made him. He makes man return to earth again, and endows him with a strength of his own.
[[Si 17,2]]Limited days of life he gives him and makes him return to earth again.
[[Si 17,3]]He endows man with a strength of his own, and with power over all things else on earth.
[[Si 17,4]]He puts the fear of him in all flesh, and gives him rule over beasts and birds.
[[Si 17,5]]He forms men's tongues and eyes and ears, and imparts to them an understanding heart.
[[Si 17,6]]With wisdom and knowledge he fills them; good and evil he shows them.
[[Si 17,7]]He looks with favor upon their hearts, and shows them his glorious works,
[[Si 17,8]]That they may describe the wonders of his deeds and praise his holy name.
[[Si 17,9]]He has set before them knowledge, a law of life as their inheritance;
[[Si 17,10]]An everlasting covenant he has made with them, his commandments he has revealed to them.
[[Si 17,11]]His majestic glory their eyes beheld, his glorious voice their ears heard.
[[Si 17,12]]He says to them, "Avoid all evil"; each of them he gives precepts about his fellow men.
[[Si 17,13]]Their ways are ever known to him, they cannot be hidden from his eyes.
